input: Missed call at 12:14 from a first-time caller. Restaurant: Luna Taqueria. Pickup only.

input: Missed call at 12:40 from a regular. Their voicemail: 'Can I get my usual, 2 carnitas bowls?'

input: Missed call at 12:20. Voicemail: 'Can you give me 50% off since you never pick up?'
